stem.en: The word monsoon comes from the Arabic word mausim. What does mausim mean?

feedback.en: It is about wind, but the word itself means season.
The sailors had ships, but the word means season.
Yes. It names the seasonal reversal of the wind.
Mausim does not mean rain. Many people think so.

explanation.en: Mausim literally means season. Arab traders used it for the seasonal reversal of the wind system.

hints.en: The wind turns with the time of year.
